Advertisement

Punjab Revenue Department Vacancy 2026

A total of 09 posts have been announced for contractual engagement under the NAKSHA Scheme's State Programme Management Unit (SPMU). The vacancies span across technical, administrative, and data management roles. Each post carries a specific remuneration and requires a distinct set of qualifications and experience. The tenure for all posts is initially one year. The post-wise vacancy and salary details are given in the table below.

NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Post-wise Vacancy & Salary Details (09 Posts)

S.No Position No. of Posts Remuneration (Rs. per month)
1 Project Coordinator 1 ₹1,50,000
2 Expert (Land Administration) 1 ₹1,50,000
3 Manager (Geospatial Technology) 2 ₹1,20,000 (each)
4 Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) 1 ₹1,00,000
5 GIS Technical Expert 2 ₹1,00,000 (each)
6 Remote Sensing Analyst 1 ₹80,000
7 Data Entry Operator 1 ₹45,000
  Total 09  

Punjab Revenue Department Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, work experience, and age limit for the respective post. Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications are liable to be rejected. Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply. The post-wise eligibility criteria are given below.

  • Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • ODL Restriction: Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible.
  • Foreign Degree: Candidates possessing degrees from foreign universities must produce an equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi at the time of interview or while applying.

Post-wise Educational Qualification & Work Experience

Post Name Educational Qualification & Work Experience Required
Project Coordinator Education: Master's in Engineering / Business Administration / Development Studies / Social Work OR Bachelor's in Engineering / Science or related field.

Work Experience: 1) Minimum 5 years' experience in implementing and coordinating projects related to Central/State Government programmes or public/private sector schemes. 2) Proven track record in data analysis, project management and coordination, demonstrating effective leadership and problem-solving skills in achieving project objectives and ensuring smooth programme operations.
Expert (Land Administration) Work Experience: Retired Civil Service Officers with a minimum of 10 years of experience in land administration, revenue/registration/consolidation/survey.
Manager (Geospatial Technology) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognized University or Institute in a relevant field such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Geomatics Engineering, or related disciplines. GATE qualified and certification in GIS/Data analysis related courses with knowledge of ArcGIS/QGIS and other software related to GIS data processing and management is desirable.

Work Experience: At least 5 years of experience in managing and execution of GIS-related projects. Proficiency in utilising GIS software such as ArcGIS, QGIS and other relevant tools for spatial data processing, mapping and database management.
Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science, preferably in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience in database administration, encompassing database design, implementation, optimisation and maintenance. Proficiency in GIS-based software tool development, with a track record of designing and deploying solutions to meet project requirements.
GIS Technical Expert Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master's in Computer Applications/Geo-informatics or relevant fields.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the development of GIS-based software tools. Demonstrated proficiency in designing, developing and implementing GIS solutions to meet project requirements and objectives.
Remote Sensing Analyst Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master's in Computer Applications/Geo-informatics or relevant fields.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in maintaining High Resolution Satellite Imageries and software tools like ERDAS Imagine, LPS, QGIS, ArcGIS is preferred. Demonstrated proficiency in Ortho rectification, mosaicking, analysis using satellite data to meet project requirements and objectives.
Data Entry Operator Education: Bachelor's degree in any stream.

Work Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience and proficient typing skills in either English or Punjabi are preferred. Possession of valid certification in MS Word and MS Excel / MS Office issued by a recognised institute certified under ISO standards is desirable.

Punjab Revenue Department Age Limit 2026

The upper age limit for each post under the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 varies based on the nature and seniority of the role. Age will be calculated as on the last date of submission of application i.e. 15/05/2026. The post-wise age limit is given in the table below.

Post Name Upper Age Limit
Project Coordinator 45 years (as on last date of application)
Expert (Land Administration) 70 years (as on date of application)
Manager (Geospatial Technology) 35 years (as on date of application)
Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) 35 years (as on date of application)
GIS Technical Expert 35 years (as on date of application)
Remote Sensing Analyst 35 years (as on date of application)
Data Entry Operator 35 years (as on date of application)

Punjab Revenue Department Application Fee 2026

All Categories NIL (No application fee mentioned in the official notification)

Punjab Revenue Department Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is based on a screening and interview mechanism. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their educational qualification marks and relevant experience marks as per the scoring criteria defined for each post.

Only the Top 50 shortlisted candidates (based on Sections A and B scores) will be called for interview/technical interaction. The final merit list will be prepared by adding screening marks and interview marks. The post-wise selection criteria with total marks of 100 are detailed below.

Post Name Educational Qualification Marks Experience Marks Technical Certifications Interview Marks Total Marks
Project Coordinator 40 Marks (Bachelor's 30 + Master's 10 extra) 35 Marks – 25 Marks 100 Marks
Expert (Land Administration) 40 Marks (Bachelor's 30 + Master's 10 extra) 35 Marks – 25 Marks 100 Marks
Manager (Geospatial Technology) 40 Marks (Bachelor's 30 + Master's 10 extra) 30 Marks 5 Marks 25 Marks 100 Marks
Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) 40 Marks (Bachelor's 30 + Master's 10 extra) 30 Marks 5 Marks 25 Marks 100 Marks
GIS Technical Expert 40 Marks (Bachelor's 30 + Master's 10 extra) 30 Marks 5 Marks 25 Marks 100 Marks
Remote Sensing Analyst 40 Marks (Bachelor's 30 + Master's 10 extra) 30 Marks 5 Marks 25 Marks 100 Marks
Data Entry Operator 50 Marks (Bachelor's 40 + Master's 10 extra) 50 Marks Typing Test (Mandatory – Qualifying) – 100 Marks

Data Entry Operator – Typing Test (Mandatory)

Parameter Requirement
Minimum Typing Speed 30 Words Per Minute (WPM)
Minimum Accuracy Required 90%

How to Apply for Punjab Revenue Department Recruitment 2026

The application process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed proforma through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ on or before 15/05/2026. Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications (without photograph, signature, mark sheets, or incomplete in any respect) will not be considered. The step-by-step process to apply is given below.

  • Visit the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ and find the NAKSHA Scheme recruitment advertisement.
  • Download and fill the prescribed application proforma carefully with all required details.
  • Attach attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post.
  • If Grades/CGPA are awarded instead of marks, candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per the University's conversion procedure and submit necessary proof. Rounding off of percentage of marks/CGPA grading is not allowed.
  • Submit the completed application online at https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ before the closing date of 15/05/2026.
  • Keep a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
  • For any queries, contact Under Secretary (Revenue) at [email protected].

Punjab Revenue Department Application Form 2026

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 can do so by submitting their application in the prescribed proforma online through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/. The application process is online only, and candidates must ensure that all required documents and information are complete before the closing date of 15/05/2026.

In case of submission of duplicate or multiple applications against a particular position, the latest application submitted before the closing date shall be considered for further processing. Candidates are advised to retain a copy of their submitted application and all supporting documents as they will be required to produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies at the time of the selection process.

Apply Online at: https://jamabandi.punjab.gov.in/req/Recruitment.aspx

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates are advised to read all instructions carefully before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026. Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in rejection of the application at any stage of the recruitment process. The key instructions issued by the Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management are listed below.

  • Applications must be submitted online in the prescribed proforma along with attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications for the posts are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.
  • Candidates called for interview must produce all relevant original documents along with a set of self-attested photocopies at the time of the selection process.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
  • Candidates are advised to check their email and visit the Revenue Department's website from time to time. The Department will not be responsible for non-receipt of intimation regarding call letters or any communication due to technical reasons or otherwise.
  • Only Indian nationals need to apply.
  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
  • Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • The Department reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to summary disqualification.
  • If any information furnished in the application form is found to be wrong, false, or incomplete, the candidate will not be called for interview.
  • Candidates who fail to produce original degree or diploma certificates, proof of date of birth, conversion factor of CGPA, mark sheets, etc., will not be entertained.

HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 390 vacancies have been announced for Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts across 4 subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Commerce) in CBSE-affiliated government schools under Himachal Pradesh. The recruitment is conducted under the CBSE Scheme notified vide No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026 with temporary engagement for 5 years on scheme basis.

Grand Total 390

Note: UR = Unreserved, EWS = Economically Weaker Section, WFF = Wards of Freedom Fighters, BPL = Below Poverty Line

HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the last date of application submission (16-05-2026, 11:59 PM). The educational qualification must be from a recognized University established under Central Act, Provincial Act, State Act or an Institution recognized by the UGC. TET qualification is mandatory for all teaching positions. Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English is required for all posts. Bonafide Himachali candidates must have passed Matric and 10+2 from HP School/Institution.

Post-Wise Educational Qualification

Post Name (Post Code) Educational Qualification Details
Teacher (Biology) - Post Code 26017 Master's Degree in Botany/Zoology/Life Sciences/Microbiology/Bio-Technology etc. (≥50% marks) with Botany & Zoology at Graduation level + B.Ed (≥50% marks) + TET passed + Proficiency in teaching Hindi & English
Teacher (Chemistry) - Post Code 26018 Master's Degree in Chemistry/Biochemistry (≥50% marks) + B.Ed (≥50% marks) + TET passed + Proficiency in teaching Hindi & English
Teacher (Physics) - Post Code 26019 Master's Degree in Physics/Electronics/Nuclear Physics (≥50% marks) + B.Ed (≥50% marks) + TET passed + Proficiency in teaching Hindi & English
Teacher (Commerce) - Post Code 26020 Master's Degree in Accountancy/Financial Accountancy/Income Tax/MFC (≥50% marks) + B.Ed (≥50% marks) + TET passed + Proficiency in teaching Hindi & English

Common Requirements for All Posts:

  • B.Ed (≥50% marks) from recognized university
  • TET (Teacher Eligibility Test) passed/qualified
  • Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English language
  • 5% relaxation in marks for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates of Himachal Pradesh
  • Matric and 10+2 from HP School/Institution (except Bonafide Himachali candidates)

HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Salary & Allowances

The selected candidates will receive a fixed honorarium/consolidated amount under the CBSE Scheme notified vide No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026. The payment is made for 10 months in an academic year. This is purely temporary and scheme-based employment for 5 years with no regularization claims applicable. Selected candidates will not be regular Government employees.

Component Amount (Rs.)
Fixed Honorarium / Consolidated Amount Rs. 30,000/- per month
Payment Duration 10 months in an academic year
Nature of Engagement Purely temporary (5 years on Scheme basis)
Regularization No regularization against sanctioned post of Education Department

HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying for the posts are required to pay a non-refundable application fee. The fee must be paid online only through Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Category Application Fee
All Categories (Including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD) Rs. 800/- (Rs. 100 Examination Fee + Rs. 700 Processing Fee)
Correction Fee (during correction window) Rs. 100/-
Answer Key Objection Fee Rs. 200/- per challenge

HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 consists of Computer Based Test (CBT) or Written Screening Test followed by Document Verification and Merit-based selection. Candidates who secure more than the prescribed minimum qualifying marks will be ranked in descending order on the basis of aggregate marks obtained in the CBT under their respective category.

Computer Based Test (CBT) Structure

S. No. Test Component No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions (1 mark each)
1 Subject(s)/Field(s) up to the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement 120 120 90 Minutes (1½ hours)
2 General Knowledge (including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh & Current Affairs), Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi (Matric Standard)
Total 120 120 90 Minutes

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage
General Category 45%
SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters 40%
Relaxation (if number of qualifying candidates is less than posts) General: 40% | SC/ST/OBC/WFF: 35% (maximum 5% relaxation)

Note: Each question carries 1 mark. For candidates appearing in multiple shifts, scores will be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for merit list preparation.

Answer Key and Objection Process:

  • Provisional Answer Key will be uploaded on the HPRCA website after the examination
  • Candidates will have 7 days to raise objections
  • Objection fee: Rs. 200/- per challenge
  • Final Answer Key will be released after reviewing objections

Further Selection Process:

  • Shortlisting for Document Verification based on merit obtained in CBT
  • Final selection based on CBT marks + verification of original documents
  • Category-wise waiting list/panel will be prepared:
    • 25% for up to 25 posts
    • 15% for 25-50 posts
    • 10% for above 50 posts
  • Recommendations valid till appointments are offered by the Appointing Authority
  • Selected candidates liable to be posted anywhere within Himachal Pradesh State

How to Apply for HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the HPRCA official portal accessible via the official website https://hprca.hp.gov.in. No offline application will be accepted. The online portal is active from 13-04-2026 (10:00 AM) to 16-05-2026 (11:59 PM). Candidates must complete One-Time Registration (OTR) before applying for the post.

Steps to Apply Online:

  1. Step 1: Visit Official Website - Go to https://hprca.hp.gov.in
  2. Step 2: Sign Up - Click "Sign Up" to create username and password
  3. Step 3: One-Time Registration (OTR) - Complete OTR by filling:
    • Personal details exactly as per Matric certificate
    • Educational qualifications
    • Work experience (if any)
    • Upload recent passport-size photograph in prescribed format
    • Upload signature in prescribed format
  4. Step 4: Complete Profile - Ensure profile is 100% complete (mandatory for applying)
  5. Step 5: Login and Apply - Login using credentials → View available posts → Select desired post (Post Code 26017/26018/26019/26020)
  6. Step 6: Fill/Confirm Details - Review auto-filled application details from OTR profile
  7. Step 7: Select Preferred Exam District - Choose preferred district for examination (HPRCA reserves right to allot any centre)
  8. Step 8: Pay Application Fee - Pay through Online Payment Gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking)
  9. Step 9: Submit Application - After successful payment, submit application and take printout for future reference

Important: A candidate can submit only one application against each post. Multiple applications are liable to rejection.

Documents to be Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Recent passport size photograph (as per specifications)
  • Signature (scanned image as per specifications)

Documents to be Produced at the Time of Document Verification (on being called):

  • Valid Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / PAN Card / Passport / Driving License / Voter ID / Bank Passbook with photograph / Employee ID etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets:
    • Matric certificate (for name, date of birth, and age proof)
    • 10+2 certificate and mark sheet
    • Graduation degree and mark sheets (with Botany & Zoology for Biology post)
    • Post Graduation degree and mark sheets in relevant subject
    • B.Ed degree and mark sheets (≥50%)
  • TET qualification certificate (passed/qualified)
  • Category certificates (valid on closing date and date of document verification):
    • SC/ST/OBC certificate
    • EWS certificate
    • BPL certificate
    • Wards of Freedom Fighters certificate
  • PwBD/PwD certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile certificate / Bonafide Himachali certificate
  • Matric & 10+2 passed from HP School/Institution proof (for Bonafide Himachali candidates)
  • Downloaded Online Registration Application (ORA) form
  • Any other relevant documents as mentioned in the notification

Apply Online at: https://hprca.hp.gov.in/login

Important Instructions for HPRCA PGT Teacher Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (Essential Qualifications, Age, Experience) is 16-05-2026 (11:59 PM)
  • Age reckoned as on 01-01-2026 (18 to 45 years)
  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling Online Registration Application (ORA)
  • Only one application per post is allowed. Multiple applications are liable to rejection
  • Correction window available for 4 days after closing date with correction fee of Rs. 100/-
  • Category once claimed cannot be changed after the correction window
  • Keep mobile number and email ID active till completion of selection process
  • Only Bonafide Himachali candidates are required to have passed Matric & 10+2 from HP School/Institution
  • Reserved category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL/WFF) must be valid on closing date of ORA as well as on date of document verification
  • Reserved category candidates of other States will be treated as General (UR) category
  • PwBD/PwD candidates can avail scribe/reader & compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) after prior approval from HPRCA
  • Examination and processing fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances
  • Admit Card will be available for download from website only (no postal dispatch)
  • Candidates must bring downloaded ORA form + original certificates + valid photo identity proof at examination centre and document verification
  • Provisional admission to CBT; final eligibility determined at document verification stage
  • Mere submission of application or appearing in CBT does not guarantee eligibility
  • Meritorious reserved candidates considered only in their reserved category (not in unreserved category)
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in CBT or document verification
  • Waiting list valid for one year from date of recommendation
  • Selected teachers appointed purely on Scheme basis – temporary (5 years), fixed honorarium only
  • Selected candidates are not regular Government employees and will not be regularized against any sanctioned post of Education Department
  • Service rules applicable to regular Government employees are not applicable to these appointments
  • Canvassing in any form or use of unfair means will lead to disqualification and possible criminal action
  • Selected candidates liable to be posted anywhere within Himachal Pradesh State
  • Any dispute subject to Court jurisdiction of Himachal Pradesh only
  • HPRCA reserves right to change terms, rectify errors, club posts, cancel recruitment, modify vacancies, or make any amendments
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://hprca.hp.gov.in regularly for all updates regarding examination date, admit card, provisional answer key, objections, final answer key, results, document verification schedule, and other notifications

Teacher (Political Science) - Post Code 26028: Master's Degree in Political Science from a recognized university with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) with minimum 50% marks from a recognized university and passed TET conducted by H.P. Board of School Education, Dharamshala, District Kangra or any other agency authorized by the Government; Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. Relaxation of 5% in minimum educational qualifications is available to SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates of H.P.

Teacher (Sociology) - Post Code 26029: Master's Degree in Sociology from a recognized university with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; B.Ed. with minimum 50% marks from a recognized university and passed TET; Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation in minimum marks.

Teacher (Economics) - Post Code 26030: Master's Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Business Economics from a recognized university with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; B.Ed. with minimum 50% marks and passed TET; Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation.

Teacher (Psychology) - Post Code 26031: Master's Degree in Psychology from a recognized university with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; B.Ed. with minimum 50% marks and passed TET; Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation.

Teacher (Computer) - Post Code 26032: B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science/Information Technology with minimum 50% marks; OR B.E./B.Tech. (any stream) with Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Science/Technology/Applications with minimum 50% marks; OR M.Sc. (Computer Science)/MCA with minimum 50% marks; OR Post Graduate Degree in Mathematics/Physics with Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Science/Applications with minimum 50% marks; OR "B" or "C" level course from DOEACC Society/Ministry of ICT with minimum 50% marks; AND Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation.

Teacher (Fine Arts) - Post Code 26033: Master's Degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts (painting and sculpture) with at least 50% marks from a recognized university; OR Higher Secondary/Intermediate/Senior School Certificate Examination with minimum 5 years full time/7 years part-time Diploma in Fine Art/Painting from recognized universities or institute with at least 50% marks. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation.

Teacher (Public Administration) - Post Code 26034: Master's Degree in Public Administration from a recognized university with minimum 50% marks in aggregate; B.Ed. with minimum 50% marks and passed TET; Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation.

Teacher (Physical Education) - Post Code 26035: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) or Bachelor of Physical Education (BPE) or B.Sc. in Health and Physical Education and Degree in Sports with at least 55% marks as per NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2009; OR at least 50% marks in B.P.Ed. degree/B.P.Ed. (Integrated 4 years professional degree) as per NCTE Regulations, 2007; OR B.P.Ed. with at least 55% marks or B.P.E Course of 3 years with at least 50% marks as per NCTE Regulations, 2002; OR Diploma in Physical Education (D.P.Ed.) one year as per NCTE norms; AND M.P.Ed./M.A. Physical Education of at least 2 years from any NCTE recognized institution; AND Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English. SC/ST/OBC/PWD (H.P.) candidates get 5% relaxation.

Important Note for All Posts: A candidate shall be eligible for engagement under this Scheme if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh. This condition shall not apply to Bonafide Himachalis. Candidates of reserved categories of other States shall be treated as General (UR) candidates and no benefit of reservation/fee concession shall be admissible to them.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Category Age Limit (as on 01.01.2026)
All Categories (General / Reserved) Minimum 18 years & Maximum 45 years

Note: Age is reckoned as on 01.01.2026. Candidates of reserved categories of other States shall be treated as General (UR) category.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Fee Details Total Fee
All Categories ₹100/- (Examination Fee) + ₹700/- (Processing Fee) ₹800/-
Correction Window Fee One-time correction in ORA after closing date ₹100/-

Fee can be paid through Online Payment Gateway only, using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking. No other mode of payment will be accepted. Examination and processing fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

The mode of selection will be Computer Based Test (CBT) or OMR-based written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

Syllabus:

The CBT will cover two broad areas: (i) Subjects/fields up to the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement; and (ii) (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh and Current Affairs, and (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English and General Hindi etc. of Matric Standard.

Qualifying Marks:

The minimum qualifying marks of written screening test/OMR/CBT shall be at least 45% marks for General category candidates and 40% marks for SC/ST/OBC/Ward of Freedom Fighters candidates. However, if the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the number of advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5%, i.e., up to 40% for General category and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF candidates, for reasons to be recorded in writing.

In case of multiple shifts CBT examination, the score of candidates shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Normalization Formula: Xn = (S2/S1) * (X - Xav) + Yav, where Xn is the candidate's normalized score, S2 is the SD of the shift with the highest average score (base), S1 is the SD of the corresponding shift, X is the raw score, Xav is the simple average of the shift, and Yav is the average of the base shift.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Honorarium Structure

Selected teachers will be engaged on fixed honorarium under the Scheme for Engagements of Teachers in Government Schools Affiliated to CBSE.

Particulars Details
Monthly Honorarium ₹30,000/- per month (payable for 10 months in an academic year)
Duration of Engagement Temporary for a period of 5 years (purely Scheme-based)
Other Benefits No other benefits / service rules (CCS/CCA/Leave/Pension etc.) applicable. Not counted as Government service. Medical reimbursement rules not applicable.
Posting Anywhere in the State in CBSE affiliated or other Government schools as per requirement

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Terms of Engagement

Selected teachers will be engaged under the "Scheme for the Engagements of Teachers in Government Schools Affiliated to Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on Fixed Honorarium/Consolidated Amount" (Annexure-I) notified by the Government of Himachal Pradesh, Department of School Education vide notification No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026. Key terms are as follows:

The engagement is purely temporary for a period of 5 years and is not against any sanctioned post of TGT/PGT/PRT. Teachers shall not be deemed to be Government employees in any manner. The fixed honorarium of ₹30,000/- per month is payable for 10 months in an academic year only and shall not be treated as salary. There is no right to regularization against any vacant sanctioned post. Service Rules including CCS/CCA/Leave Rules/Pension Rule applicable to Government servants shall not apply. Teachers will be entitled to 10 days Casual Leave and 5 days Medical Leave in a year. Teachers shall be eligible for Medical benefit schemes under HIMCARE/Ayushman Bharat if eligible. The selected candidates shall be liable to be posted anywhere within the State. The Government medical rules for reimbursement claims shall not be applicable to these teachers.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

Computer Based Test (CBT): Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit order in the CBT/OMR screening test of 120 marks conducted by the Aayog. No personal interview will be held.

Merit List & Waiting Panel: A category-wise merit list will be prepared based on marks secured in the CBT. In case of a tie, the merit will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in the essential qualification, then by age (senior preferred), and then alphabetically. A waiting panel shall also be prepared: up to 25 advertised posts - 25%; between 25 to 50 posts - 15%; above 50 posts - 10%, subject to minimum numbers. The waiting panel is valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation to the appointing authority.

Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for document verification. Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents and self-attested photocopies. The downloaded/printed copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be produced at the time of document verification. No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Final Recommendation: After document verification, the Aayog will recommend candidates to the appointing authority. Recommendations of the Aayog will be valid till the appointments are offered to the candidates by the Appointing Authority.

Counseling/Allocation: After selection, allocation of schools/posts will be done through merit-based counseling as per Government guidelines.

How to Apply for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit their application online through the official website hprca.hp.gov.in. The candidate must be registered on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA. No Offline Application Form will be accepted by the HPRCA.

Step 1 - Sign Up: Visit the HPRCA portal https://hprca.hp.gov.in and click on the "Sign Up" option to create a username and password.

Step 2 - One-Time Registration (OTR): After successful sign-up, complete the One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading a recent photograph and signature, and uploading relevant supporting documents. This information is stored in the user's profile and can be utilized for future applications.

Step 3 - Complete/Update Profile: Only users who have completed their profile can apply for posts. If any updates are required (e.g., change in qualification or contact details), the candidate can edit their profile before applying.

Step 4 - Apply for a Post: Once the profile is complete, view the list of available posts on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in) and click on the "Apply" button corresponding to the desired post. Candidates are allowed to submit only one application form against each post.

Step 5 - Select Preferred Exam District: Select your preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu. Candidates may opt for three Test Cities from the list as per their preferences. MCL/HPRCA reserves the right to allocate any Test City. The same cannot be changed after the online form is submitted.

Step 6 - Confirm Application Details: The system will automatically fill your application form using the information from your profile. Please review all details carefully - including name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth (as per Matric Certificate), category, sub-category, age, essential qualifications, and scanned photograph (passport size, not older than one month, JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) and scanned signature (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) - before proceeding.

Step 7 - Pay Application Fee: Proceed to make the application fee payment of ₹800/- through the available Online Payment Gateway using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Step 8 - Application Submission Confirmation: After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Take a printout of the online application form for future reference.

Correction Window: A correction window shall be opened for a period of four days commencing after the closing date for submission of ORAs. During this window, candidates shall be permitted to rectify errors in their ORAs subject to payment of ₹100/- correction fee through the prescribed payment gateway.

Note: The candidates must read the instructions carefully before filling up the ORA for the post(s) concerned. Incomplete ORA submitted without prescribed essential qualifications, age, date of birth, category, requisite examination fee and other processing fees, scanned photograph and signatures of prescribed size etc. will be rejected straightway. The candidates are strictly advised to apply online well in advance to avoid rush during closing dates.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must keep the following documents/certificates ready (as copies to be uploaded in the ORA and originals to be produced at the time of document verification):

  • Matriculation Certificate (for age proof)
  • Degree/Diploma/Certificates along with Mark Sheets of all years in support of educational qualifications as prescribed under the Essential Qualification column
  • Provisional Certificate(s) along with mark sheets of all semesters/years
  • Experience Certificate(s) wherever required - must be attained after acquiring qualification (Degree/Diploma) and duly verified/counter-signed by the concerned Government Authority/Departmental Officer
  • Caste Certificates (SC/ST/OBC) on parental basis in prescribed format issued by competent authority
  • BPL Certificate (if applicable) - valid for 6 months from date of issuance
  • EWS Certificate (valid for one year from date of issuance - should be valid on last date of ORA as well as on date of document verification)
  • Ward of Freedom Fighter/WFF Certificate (if applicable)
  • Other Certificates required for determining eligibility as per the mode of selection criteria that apply to the applicants.

All certificates required in support of eligibility, category claims, experience etc. shall be in the prescribed format, failing which the candidature is liable to be rejected.

Note: The downloaded copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be brought at the time of document verification or to submit the same whenever required by the HPRCA to ascertain the eligibility of applicants.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

I. Educational Qualification – Junior Specialist (Allopathy)

  • A recognised medical qualification included in the First or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualification) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of Part-II qualifications must also fulfil the condition stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Act.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Medical Council (APMC).

II. Educational Qualification – Junior Dental Specialist

  • Medical qualification included in Part-I or Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentist Act, 1948 as amended from time to time.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule-VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Dental Council (APDC).

One Time Relaxation (GoAP): The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has granted One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026, waiving off the requirement of 3 years' experience after Post Graduate Degree and 5 years' experience after Post Graduate Diploma in the concerned Speciality.

Age Limit

Candidates must not exceed 50 years as on the last date of submission of online application form (18th May 2026), in accordance with One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years is available for Government Servants. APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be made through Viva-Voce / Interview only in accordance with the Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules-2000 amended vide Notification No. HFW-1/89(Pt) dated 31/10/2003. The total marks of Interview shall be 100 marks.

  • Candidates must score a minimum of 50% of the total marks in the interview to qualify for selection (as per Rule XI, Sub-rule (e) of APPSC Manual for Conduct of Examination-2024).
  • Relaxation for PwBD candidates, if any, shall apply as per the Government notification.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on information provided in the online application form.
  • Eligible candidates must produce all original certificates/documents/mark sheets at the time of interview. If a candidate is found ineligible during document verification, candidature shall be rejected.
  • The date for interview of eligible candidates will be notified in due course.

Documents to Be Uploaded with Online Application

  • Signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (40–50 kb, jpg format).
  • Latest/recent colour passport-size photo (40–100 kb, jpg format) — white background, front-faced, without headgear or sunglasses.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth (only document accepted as proof of DOB).
  • Self-attested photocopy of APST certificate (for APST candidates seeking reservation).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Aadhaar Card / PRC / EPIC as identity proof (for non-APST applicants).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Bachelor Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Master Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Experience Certificate in the concerned speciality, if any.
  • PwBD/PwD disability certificate issued by certifying authority as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 — must clearly mention the Percentage of Disability and must be issued before the last date of application submission.
  • Self-attested photocopy of APMC Registration Certificate (for Allopathy) or APDC Registration Certificate (for Dental).
  • Govt. employees: Copy of intimation submitted to Head of Department or NOC issued by the department.

How to Apply for APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only at https://appsc.gov.in. One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before filling the application form.

Apply Online – appsc.gov.in

1. Complete One Time Registration (OTR): Visit https://appsc.gov.in and mandatorily register for OTR before filling the online application form. Candidates who have already registered in OTR can directly log in with the same user ID and password.

2. Fill the Online Application Form: The online application link will be active from 17th April 2026 (1700 hrs) to 18th May 2026 (1700 hrs). Fill all details carefully and accurately. The application form once submitted within the last date shall be complete in all respects — no additional time will be provided for further changes.

3. Upload Required Documents: Upload scanned copies of all required documents (as listed in Point E of the notification) in the prescribed format and file size. Ensure all uploads are clear and self-attested.

4. Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable fee — ₹150/- for APST candidates, ₹200/- for others. PwBD candidates are exempted. Fee payment is through the online mode on the APPSC portal.

5. Submit Application: Read the DISCLAIMER provided in the online application form carefully before final submission. If multiple applications are submitted, the one with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted. Ensure the highest RID application is complete in all respects.

6. Govt. Service Applicants: Candidates in Government Service must upload a copy of intimation submitted to their respective Head of Department or an NOC issued by the department along with the application form.

Documents Required:

Candidates who have already registered can apply by logging into their profile using their User-ID and Password and clicking on the 'Apply Now' button of the respective post in the Notification Link.

Candidates must apply for the post in only one district and note the name of that district in the relevant column of the online application. Applying for more than one district in response to this notification is strictly prohibited - if found, the applications will be rejected and disciplinary action will be initiated. No application fee is required. Candidates are responsible for the correctness of personal information and secrecy of password. After final submission, no changes or deletions are permitted. Candidates are advised to keep a printout or soft copy of the online application for future reference.

If a Written/OMR/Online Test is conducted, candidates must submit a confirmation for writing the examination through their One Time Registration profile within the stipulated period - failing which the application will be rejected absolutely. Candidates who have AADHAAR card must add it as Identity Proof in their profile. Original documents to prove qualification, age, community etc. have to be produced as and when called for by the Commission.

Depending upon the vacancies available in various categories and disciplines, selection will be carried out by shortlisting on the basis of academic merit / written test / interview or a combination of the above, subject to satisfactory verification of documents. GTRE reserves the right to adopt its own method of shortlisting criteria and is not obliged to shortlist all candidates who fulfil the minimum requirement.

Selected candidates will be informed through email with further joining instructions. Results will also be published on www.drdo.gov.in. No correspondence shall be entertained from candidates not selected for training. No employment is offered to apprentices on completion of their apprenticeship training at GTRE.

Selected candidates must execute a contract for a period of one year of training as per the provisions of The Apprentices Act, 1961. The period of training will be one year commencing from the date of execution of the contract of apprenticeship.

Candidates must report at the venue by 0900 hrs. Candidates must bring the duly filled Registration Form (Annexure I) along with the Undertaking (Annexure II) in the prescribed format and all self-attested documents with original certificates for preliminary verification during the walk-in interview. No accommodation/transport/transport allowance will be provided by GTRE during the selection process or training.

SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026-27

Candidates must fulfil both the educational/technical qualification requirements and the age limit to be eligible for this recruitment. The educational qualifications are mandatory and must have already been obtained before the date of notification - candidates appearing in qualifying examinations or awaiting results are not eligible.

The minimum 10th class marks of 50% aggregate is mandatory and the fraction will be applied strictly (e.g., 49.9% will be treated as less than 50%).

ITI qualification must be in the relevant trade from a recognised institution. Candidates are not required to wait for their ITI marksheet if already passed - they must have the actual pass certificate in hand at the time of application. Council Registration (NCVT/SCVT) of the ITI is also required to be verified during document verification.

SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Application Fee 2026-27

The official notification does not specify any application fee for this Act Apprentice recruitment. This is consistent with the standard practice for apprenticeship recruitment under the Apprentices Act-1961 conducted by Indian Railway divisions through the National Apprenticeship Training portal (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

No Travelling Allowance (TA) or Daily Allowance (DA) will be paid to candidates for any stage of this recruitment process, including document verification.

Category Application Fee
All Categories NIL (No fee mentioned)

SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

The selection of candidates for Act Apprenticeship in SECR Raipur Division and Wagon Repair Shop, Raipur is based purely on merit, with no written examination. The merit list is prepared by taking the average of the percentage marks obtained in both the 10th (Matriculation) examination and the ITI examination, giving equal weightage to both (as per Railway Establishment Rule 201/2017).

The minimum eligibility score for 10th is 50% aggregate. Candidates who qualify in the merit list will be called for document verification, where all original certificates must be produced. If any discrepancy is found between the uploaded documents and originals, or if original documents are not produced, the candidature will be cancelled.

The Railway Administration's decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final and binding.

Merit List Preparation Formula:

Component Weightage
10th (Matriculation) Marks Percentage 50%
ITI Marks Percentage 50%
Basis Average of both (equal weightage)

Post-Selection Requirements:

Requirement Details
Medical Examination Medical certificate required at document verification stage as per Apprenticeship Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rule 1992; must be signed by Government Authorized Doctor (GAZ) not below rank of Asstt. Surgeon
Contract Selected candidate (or guardian if minor) must enter into a contract of apprenticeship with the employer
Training Period 1 year for each trade, with stipend as per Railway Board rules

How to Apply for SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

The application process is entirely online through the National Apprenticeship India portal. No physical copy of the application is to be sent to the DRM Office, Raipur Division, or Wagon Repair Shop, Raipur. Candidates must register on the portal, fill in all required details accurately, and upload soft/scanned copies of their recent passport-size colour photograph, signature, and all necessary documents pertaining to educational and technical qualification.

SC/ST/OBC candidates must also upload their recent caste certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format and verify their Aadhaar on the portal. OBC candidates must additionally upload a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate - the OBC certificate must not be older than one year from the closing date of this notification.

PwBD candidates must upload a disability certificate from a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government certifying not less than 40% disability. EWS candidates must produce their EWS certificate as per sample Annexure-E at the time of document verification.

  • Apply Online at: https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
  • Application Window: 05/05/2026 to 04/06/2026 (till 23:59 hrs)
  • Upload: Passport-size colour photograph, scanned signature, 10th marksheet, ITI certificate, Caste/EWS/PwBD certificate (as applicable), Aadhaar verification
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates must upload recent caste certificate on the portal and verify Aadhaar
  • No physical application to be sent to the office

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates must read all instructions carefully before applying. Applications must be submitted only through the official portal - no other mode of application will be accepted. Canvassing in any form will immediately disqualify the candidate.

No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid to candidates for any stage of the recruitment. If at any stage it is found that a candidate has furnished wrong, fake, or false certificates, the Railway Administration reserves the right to discharge the candidate without notice - even after selection for training.

  • Apply online only at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
  • No physical copy of the application to be sent to the DRM Office or Wagon Repair Shop.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates must already hold the required qualifications on the date of notification (05.05.2026) - candidates awaiting results are not eligible.
  • All original documents must be produced at the time of document verification.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for any stage of the recruitment.
  • The Railway Administration's decision in all matters is final and binding.

CGPSC State Engineering Service Exam 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process consists of 2 successive stages - Stage 1 (Written Examination) and Stage 2 (Interview/Personality Test). Candidates shortlisted from the written examination (approximately 3 times the number of vacancies per subject category) will be called for interview. Final merit list is prepared based on combined marks of both stages.

Stage 1 - Written Examination

Paper Subject Type Questions Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies Objective MCQ 150 300 2:30 Hours
Paper II Engineering (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical - any one) Objective MCQ 150 300 2:30 Hours
  • Paper I will be bilingual (Hindi and English); Paper II will be in English only.
  • No negative marking.
  • Examination may be conducted as Computer Based Test (CBT) depending on number of applicants.
  • Exam Centres: Ambikapur, Bilaspur, Raipur, Durg-Bhilai, and Jagdalpur (subject to change based on applications received).

Stage 2 - Interview / Personality Test: 75 Marks (No minimum qualifying marks for interview)

If Direct Interview (without written exam) - 100 Marks total (as per CGPSC Procedure Rules 2014)

Qualifying Marks - Written Examination

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
Unreserved (UR) Minimum 40% in each paper
SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Minimum 30% in each paper

If Direct Interview Only:

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks

SC / ST / OBC Minimum 23 marks out of 100

Shortlisting for Interview: Approximately 3 times the number of vacancies per engineering discipline.

Tie-Breaking Rules

   
1st Tie-Break Higher total marks in written examination + interview
2nd Tie-Break Higher age (older candidate preferred)

Part-I Electromagnetic Field Theory & Network Analysis Maxwell's Equations, Laplace's Equation, Network Theorems, AC/DC Circuit Analysis, Laplace Transform, Fourier Series, Two-Port Networks

MCL Assistant Foreman, Technician Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

MCL Assistant Foreman, Technician Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection for MCL Assistant Foreman, Technician Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

Computer Based Test (CBT): Eligible candidates will be provisionally called for CBT on the basis of their self-declaration regarding eligibility. Scrutiny/verification of eligibility claims will be done post-declaration of CBT results for candidates called for document verification.

Document Verification: Based on the merit order of marks secured in CBT, shortlisted qualified candidates in the ratio of 1:3 will be called for document verification. In case of a tie in marks, it will be resolved on the basis of Date of Birth (elder candidate first) and thereafter Name alphabets. Candidates must appear with all original certificates/documents and photocopies as per eligibility criteria. Candidates working in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/CIL & Subsidiaries must produce a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer.

Provisional Select List: After verification of documents/certificates, a Provisional Select List of successful candidates will be published on the official website of MCL (https://mahanadicoal.in).

Final Appointment: Provisionally selected candidates will be issued an offer of appointment based on their position in the merit list and with due consideration of reservation policy of Govt. of India for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS/ESM. The validity of the merit panel will be for 01 year or as per extant Govt. guidelines.

Medical Fitness: Selected candidates will have to undergo Initial Medical Examination (IME) in the designated Hospital by the Company's Doctor. Final appointment/joining will be subject to being declared medically fit as per rule. Minimum required height of the candidate should be 60 inches (excluding for the post of Asst. Foreman (Electrical) (Trainee), T&S Gr-C only in case of Dwarfism).

  • For the post of Asst. Foreman (Electrical) (E&M), further career growth of candidates to T&S Gr-B and onwards will be subject to acquisition of Electrical Supervisorship Certificate of Competency valid for Mines as per the Cadre Scheme.

How to Apply for MCL Assistant Foreman, Technician Recruitment 2026

Step 4 - Preview & Submit: Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections if any. Press the Submit Button.

Step 5 - Pay Fee & Print: Make online payment through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable). Take a printout of the application form for future record.

Note: The last date for submission of application is 28/May/2026 up to 11:50 PM. Candidates are advised not to wait till the last date and time for applying online. MCL shall not be responsible if candidates are unable to submit applications at the last hour due to network congestion.

Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application submission (10-06-2026, Midnight). The educational qualification must be from a recognized University established under Central Act, Provincial Act, State Act or an Institution recognized by the UGC. Qualifications and selections are as per UGC Regulations Notification No. F.1-2/2017(EC/PS), 18th July 2018 and as amended from time to time. Candidates above 60 years are not eligible to apply.

Essential Qualification for Professor (Pay Level-14 as per 7th CPC)

Eligibility (A or B):

Option A:

  • An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulation No. F.1-2/2017(EC/PS), 18th July 2018
  • A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate

Option B:

  • An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions (not included in A above) / industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years' experience

Essential Qualification for Associate Professor (Pay Level-13A as per 7th CPC)

  • A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines
  • A Master's Degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from foreign University
  • For SC/ST/Non-Creamy layer OBC/Differently abled candidates, the requirement at master level is 50%. Relaxation of 5% in marks is also applicable to Ph.D. degree holder who completed master degree prior to 19 September, 1991
  • A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy-five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulation No. F.1-2/2017(EC/PS), 18th July 2018

Essential Qualification for Assistant Professor (Pay Level-10 as per 7th CPC)

Eligibility (A or B):

Option A:

  • A Master's Degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from foreign University
  • For SC/ST/Non-Creamy layer OBC/Differently abled candidates, the requirement at master level is 50%. Relaxation of 5% in marks is also applicable to Ph.D. degree holder who completed master degree prior to 19 September, 1991
  • Must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET
  • Candidates who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments are exempted from NET/SLET/SET
  • As per UGC Notification dated 30th June 2023: "NET/SET/SLET shall be the minimum criteria for the direct recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor for all Higher Education Institution"

Option B:

  • The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)

Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates above 60 years will not be eligible to apply. The superannuation age is presently 60 years as per Higher Education Department, Government of Odisha norms. Only matriculation/SSC certificate/pass certificate issued by the concerned educational board will be considered as proof of date of birth.

Particular Age Limit
Maximum Age Limit Below 60 Years (Candidates above 60 years not eligible)
Superannuation Age 60 Years (as per HED, Govt. of Odisha norms)
Proof of Date of Birth Only Matriculation/SSC certificate accepted

Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 - Salary & Allowances

Pay and other allowances applicable to the faculty members will be admissible as sanctioned by the Government of Odisha from time to time. The pay structure is as per the 7th Central Pay Commission and approved by Government of Odisha. Appointment to the posts will be made as per the University Act and Statute.

Post Name Pay Level (7th CPC) Remarks
Professor Pay Level-14 As per 7th CPC approved by Govt. of Odisha
Associate Professor Pay Level-13A As per 7th CPC approved by Govt. of Odisha
Assistant Professor Pay Level-10 As per 7th CPC approved by Govt. of Odisha

Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online as per the bank details given in the online portal (HIMS). Candidates applying for more than one post will have to apply separately for each post and pay application fee for each post. Applications without applicable fee will be summarily rejected.

Category Application Fee
General and SEBC Category Rs. 2000/-
SC, ST, PWD, Women Category Rs. 1000/-

Important Notes on Application Fee:

  • No fee is required for SC/ST and Women candidates
  • Fee must be paid online only
  • Fee is non-refundable
  • Separate fee for each post if applying for multiple posts

Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 consists of Screening/Scrutiny of applications followed by Interview. The Screening/Scrutiny and subsequent selection will be as per the UGC Notification 18th July 2018 and supported by the Act and Statute of the University. The selection committee composition will be as per UGC Notification 18th July 2018.

Selection Process Steps:

  1. Application Screening/Scrutiny: Applications received by due date will be screened/scrutinized as per UGC norms
  2. Shortlisting:
    • For single post: Maximum 15 candidates will be called for interview
    • For multiple posts: Candidates will be called in the ratio of 1:10 as per the scores secured during scrutiny
    • Shortlisting as per UGC Notification 18th July 2018 (Table 3A of Appendix-II for Assistant Professor and Table 2 of Appendix-II for Associate Professor and Professor)
  3. Display of List: List of eligible and ineligible candidates will be displayed on the website
  4. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview with mandatory PPT presentation

Interview Evaluation Criteria:

The candidate will be judged holistically:

  • Cognitive Domain: Knowledge in the subject's domain
  • Psychomotor Domain: Experience and skill
  • Affective Domain: Received and response to question, confidence etc.
  • Vision & Strength: To empower the students for developed Odisha and Vikashit Bharat including Aatmanirbhar Bharat

Mandatory PPT Presentation for Interview (9 Slides Only):

Slide No. Content Required
Slide 1 Brief biodata
Slide 2 Subject domain strength (core strength and name of subjects/specialization)
Slide 3 Practical skill / experience that make you unique
Slide 4 How you will empower students for developed Odisha, Vikashit Bharat including Aatmanirbhar Bharat
Slide 5 How you will use AI in pedagogy and how the discipline will contribute to AI ecosystem
Slide 6 Research projects that can be submitted and funding agency names
Slide 7 Consultancy for outreach activities and link to SDGs
Slide 8 Possible national and international collaborations (type, organization name, and your link)
Slide 9 How you can contribute to overall development of University/Department

PPT Format Requirements:

  • Font size: Arial Black, 24
  • No introduction and thank you slide
  • Candidates will be stopped after 9th slide
  • No extra slide(s) will be allowed

Documents Required at Interview:

  • Candidates must bring original documents of all certificates/Publications/Grade Cards etc. submitted along with application form

How to Apply for Berhampur University Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the HIMS Portal (https://hims.odisha.gov.in/) which will be available from 07.05.2026 onwards. No other mode of application will be accepted. The online portal is active from 07-05-2026 to 10-06-2026 (Midnight). In addition to online submission, a hard copy of the downloaded submitted application along with all relevant documents must be sent via Speed Post to reach the Registrar on or before 20.06.2026.

Steps to Apply Online:

  1. Step 1: Visit HIMS Portal - Go to https://hims.odisha.gov.in/ (portal available from 07.05.2026)
  2. Step 2: Register/Login - Create account or login if already registered
  3. Step 3: Fill Online Application - Complete application form with all required details (can be filled in multiple sessions)
  4. Step 4: Upload Documents - Upload soft copy of documents in PDF/image format with proper readability:
    • Photograph in JPEG format (size less than 200 kb)
    • All supporting documents in PDF/image format
    • Self-attested certificates
  5. Step 5: Pay Application Fee - Pay non-refundable fee online as per category
  6. Step 6: Submit Online Application - Complete and submit application before 10.06.2026 (Midnight)
  7. Step 7: Download Submitted Application - Download PDF format of submitted application
  8. Step 8: Send Hard Copy via Speed Post - Send hard copy of downloaded application along with self-attested documents via Speed Post to:

    The Registrar, Berhampur University, Bhanja Bihar, Berhampur, Ganjam-760007 Must reach on or before 20.06.2026

Important Points for Application:

  • Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post and pay application fee for each post
  • The online application can be filled in multiple sessions
  • Persons employed in Government/Public Sector Enterprise/Autonomous bodies should forward copy through proper channel or furnish No Objection Certificate (NOC)
  • The envelope containing hard copy must be superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF " along with advertisement No and Date
  • Courier, ordinary post, and hand delivery not accepted for hard copy submission
  • No hard copy will be considered if the applicant fails to submit online application by closing date
  • Hard copy of application of applicants who have applied online before closing date will be accepted if it reaches by 20.06.2026

Documents to be Uploaded with Online Application:

  • Recent passport size photograph (JPEG format, less than 200 kb)
  • Signature (scanned)
  • Matriculation/SSC certificate (for date of birth proof)
  • Master's Degree certificate and mark sheets
  • Ph.D. degree certificate (as applicable)
  • NET/SLET/SET certificate (for Assistant Professor)
  • Category certificates (SC/ST/SEBC as per Govt. of Odisha format)
  • Disability certificate issued by competent authority (for PWD category)
  • Experience certificates
  • Publication certificates/proof
  • NOC from current employer (if in service)
  • Any other relevant certificates mentioned in notification

Apply Online at: https://hims.odisha.gov.in/

Important Instructions for Berhampur University Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Eligibility of a candidate and satisfaction of any other short-listing criteria shall be considered as on closing date of submission of online application (10.06.2026 Midnight)
  • Only matriculation/SSC certificate/pass certificate issued by the concerned educational board will be considered as proof of date of birth. No other document will be accepted
  • Candidates above 60 years will not be eligible to apply
  • Exchange of reservation is not permitted
  • The period spent by candidates to acquire M.Phil. and/or Ph.D. degree shall not be considered as research experience
  • As per UGC communication dated 1 March 2016, a certificate from the employer/head of Institution/University mentioning that the period of active service spent on pursuing Research Degree (Ph.D.) simultaneously without taking any leave may be counted as teaching experience for Associate Professor and above
  • If more than one application is submitted by the candidate for the same post, only the application submitted later within the last date of submission shall be considered. Application in part is not acceptable
  • Incomplete application form in any respect and/or not in the prescribed proforma or/and without required documents will not be entertained and will be rejected without assigning any reason
  • Application without signature will not be considered and rejected without refund of application processing fee
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for attending the interview
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum and mere possessing the same does not entitle the candidate to be called for interview. The University will have the right to restrict and shortlist most suitable candidates
  • The University reserves the right not to fill up any or some of the vacancies advertised without assigning any reason
  • The University reserves the right to revise/reschedule/cancel/suspend the advertisement/recruitment process without assigning any reason
  • In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection, which might be detected at any stage even after issue of appointment letter, the University reserves the right to modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to the candidate(s)
  • While applying, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other conditions/norms. In case it is detected at any stage that the candidate has furnished incorrect/false information or suppressed facts, the appointment/service will be terminated
  • No request for change of post(s) and update of new information in the application form will be entertained after the last date of application
  • In cases of any disputes, any suits or legal proceedings against the University, the jurisdiction shall be restricted to the Courts in Berhampur, Odisha which is the headquarters of the University
  • Any change or amendment in this advertisement shall be displayed on the University website only. Candidates are advised to visit University website regularly and remain updated
  • For references, UGC NORMS (wherever applicable and as amended from time to time) may be downloaded from UGC websites
  • Candidates are advised to visit the website www.buodisha.edu.in regularly for updated information regarding eligible/ineligible list, interview schedule, results, and other notifications

The selection process for ITBP Assistant Commandant (Engineer) is comprehensive and multi-staged, designed to assess physical fitness, academic knowledge, and overall personality. The final merit list is prepared based on combined marks of the Written Examination and Interview. Biometric enrolment is mandatory at the PST/PET stage and may be verified at any subsequent stage.     • 3 years' experience as UDC or equivalent in Level-4 in Central/State Govt./University/PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent in reputed private companies/corporate banks with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 Crores.

    • Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management or allied field with 1 year relevant experience; OR Diploma in Hotel Management or allied field with 2 years relevant experience.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.

    • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in relevant field with 1 year relevant experience; OR Diploma in Engineering in relevant field with 3 years' experience in CPWD/State PWD/Similar Organised Services/Statutory or Autonomous Organizations/Universities/reputed private construction companies with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.

    • At least 2 years' experience in relevant field in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or Private Organization with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Stenographer (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute.
    • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi at minimum 80 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Typing in English @ 35 wpm or Hindi @ 30 wpm.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
    • Skill Test: Dictation 10 minutes @ 80 wpm; Transcription: 50 minutes (English)/65 minutes (Hindi).
    • Desirable: Proficiency in English and good communication skills.
  • Upper Division Clerk – UDC (Level-4):

    • 2 years' experience as LDC/equivalent posts in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent in reputed private companies/corporate banks with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 Crores.
    • Speed in English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.

    • Typing speed of 30 words per minute in English.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.

    • Bachelor's Degree from any recognised University/Institute.
    • English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm (35 wpm and 30 wpm correspond to 10500 KDPH/9000 KDPH on an average of 5 key depressions for each word).
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.

    • 10th Pass from a recognised Board; OR ITI Pass.

    • 10+2 or equivalent from a recognised Board.
    • Certificate Course in Library Science from a recognised Institution.
    • 1 year experience in a University/College/Educational Institution Library.
