    • 10+2 or equivalent with Science from a recognised Board.
    • 1 year experience as Attendant in related field in any Government/recognised hospitals/diagnostics centres/accredited centres.
    • Knowledge of Computer.

Salary/Stipend

  • Registrar: Pay Level-14 – Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200 (as per 7th CPC)
  • Assistant Registrar & System Analyst: Pay Level-10 – Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500
  • Section Officer & Nursing Officer: Pay Level-07 – Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400
  • Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant: Pay Level-06 – Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400
  • Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab. & Computer Lab.): Pay Level-05 – Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300
  • Stenographer, Upper Division Clerk & Library Assistant: Pay Level-04 – Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100
  • Lower Division Clerk & Driver: Pay Level-02 – Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200
  • Multi-Tasking Staff, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser: Pay Level-01 – Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900

Age Limit 

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years.
  • Assistant Registrar & System Analyst: Not exceeding 40 years.
  • Section Officer, Nursing Officer, Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant: Not exceeding 35 years.
  • Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra & Computer Lab.), Stenographer, UDC, Library Assistant, LDC, Driver, MTS, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser: Not exceeding 32 years.
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other eligible reserved categories.
  • Regular employees of Central/State Govt./Central Universities/UGC maintained Institutions/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies: Age relaxation as per Govt. of India rules.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Upper age limit for Group 'C' posts is relaxable up to 40 years (General) and 45 years (SC/ST) for candidates who have rendered 3 years continuous regular service.
  • Deputation candidates for posts below Pay Level-14: Must be less than 56 years of age; for Pay Level-14 and above: less than 58 years of age.

Application Fee

Pay Level Posts General / OBC / EWS SC / ST / PwBD
Level-10 to Level-14 Registrar, Assistant Registrar & System Analyst Rs. 3,000/- Rs. 1,500/-
Level-6 to Level-9 Section Officer, Nursing Officer, Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant Rs. 2,000/- Rs. 1,000/-
Level-1 to Level-5 Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab.), Technical Assistant (Computer Lab.), Stenographer, UDC, Library Assistant, LDC, Driver, MTS, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser Rs. 1,000/- (including Ex-Servicemen) Rs. 500/-
  • Fee payment mode: Online only through the SAMARTH portal link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Separate fee is required for each post applied for.
  • Applications submitted without requisite fee shall be rejected.
  • Any other mode of payment except online shall not be accepted.

Selection Process

  • Most posts will be filled through Direct Recruitment; certain posts through Deputation or Direct Recruitment failing which by Deputation.
  • Eligible candidates will undergo a Written Test (OMR Based / Descriptive) in the first instance.
  • Candidates shortlisted through Written Test will be called for Skill Test and/or Interview (as applicable to the post).
  • Examination Centres: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata & Bengaluru (candidate may choose one city).
  • Examination Schedules (to avoid conflicts):
    • Schedule 1: System Analyst, Junior Engineer, Assistant, Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab.), Driver.
    • Schedule 2: Section Officer, Technical Assistant (Computer Lab.), Personal Assistant, Professional Assistant, Multi-Tasking Staff.
    • Schedule 3: Assistant Registrar, Upper Division Clerk, Library Assistant, Stenographer, Medical Attendant/Dresser, Library Attendant.
    • Schedule 4: Nursing Officer, Guest House Manager, Lower Division Clerk.
  • Candidates applying for multiple posts within the same Schedule cannot appear for both simultaneously.
  • For Registrar post: Direct/Deputation for tenure of 5 years or till superannuation (62 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Detailed Scheme of Examination and Syllabus available at: https://www.sanskrit.nic.in/scheme_of_exam.php

General Information / Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted Online through the SAMARTH Link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/ available on the University's website www.sanskrit.nic.in under "Recruitment/Notification".
  • After online submission, candidates must send a duly signed hard copy of the application along with self-attested copies of all supporting documents through Registered Post within 15 days from the last date of online application.
  • Hard copy for Registrar post to be sent to: The Vice Chancellor, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • Hard copy for all other posts to be sent to: The Registrar, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • Mere possession of eligibility conditions does not entitle a candidate to be called for written/skill tests.
  • Candidates must apply separately for each post with separate requisite fee.
  • The University posts belong to All-India Cadre — once appointed, transfer requests will not be considered for a minimum lock-in period of 10 years.
  • Candidates currently in service (State/Central Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer at the time of document verification/interview.
  • PwBD candidates with less than 40% benchmark disability must submit a valid Disability Certificate uploaded with the application.
  • OBC NCL certificate must be issued on or after 01.04.2025 to be considered valid for this advertisement.
  • EWS certificate (current financial year) must be valid on or before the last date of online application submission.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid technical issues.
  • All future updates/notices will be published only on www.sanskrit.nic.in — candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • For technical support during online application: [email protected]
  • In case of any dispute, jurisdiction shall be Hon'ble Courts in Delhi.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official CSU website: www.sanskrit.nic.in under the "Recruitment/Notification" section.
  • Register and apply online through the SAMARTH Link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/
  • Upload clear, high-quality scanned copies of all requisite documents during online application.
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online only through the payment link in the application portal.
  • After successful online submission, print a signed hard copy of the application form.
  • Send the signed hard copy along with self-attested copies of all supporting documents through Registered Post within 15 days from the last date of online application (04/06/2026) to the appropriate address:
    • For Registrar Post: The Vice Chancellor, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
    • For all other posts: The Registrar, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • The last date for online application is 20 May 2026 by 11:30 PM (IST).
  • Candidates must complete both steps (online submission + hard copy submission) within the prescribed timelines; failure to comply with either may lead to rejection.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Age Limit

The age limit for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is between 18 and 30 years, calculated as on the crucial date of 01.08.2026. Candidates must have been born not before 02.08.1996 and not later than 01.08.2008 to be eligible. Age relaxation is applicable to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

General / OBC / EWS (Male) ₹100/-
Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen NIL (Exempted)

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

Paper Mode Subject Questions / Marks Duration
Paper-I (Objective) Computer Based Part-I: General Hindi
Part-II: General English		 100/100
100/100		 2 Hours (Sectional timer: 1 hr each part)
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}
Paper-II (Descriptive) Pen & Paper Translation (Hindi ↔ English) & Essay 200 Marks 2 Hours
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • Read the official notice carefully before applying; English version prevails in case of dispute.
  • Only one online application is permitted per candidate; multiple applications will be rejected.
  • Name, DOB, father's name, and mother's name must match the Matriculation Certificate exactly.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of their application for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Post preference must be submitted online before FRTA declaration; options once submitted are final.
  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.
  • Regularly check https://ssc.gov.in for updates on exam dates, vacancies, admit cards, and results.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (DME/RME).

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature.
    • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

  3. Register by providing basic details and generate Provisional Registration Number & Password.
  4. Fill the online application form carefully (personal details, educational qualification, trade/post applied, State/UT of domicile, etc.).
  5. Upload scanned copies of recent colour passport size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) through BHIM, UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or CSC Wallet.
  7. Submit the application and take printout of the application form & e-receipt for future reference.
  8. Candidates should bring two coloured printouts of the Admit Card at every stage of examination.

BPSSC Havildar Instructor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for BPSSC Havildar Instructor Recruitment 2026 consists of 2 (two) successive stages - a Written Competitive Examination of 100 marks (MCQ/Objective type, 2 hours) and a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) of 100 marks. The written examination is only qualifying for the PET; the final merit list will be based solely on marks obtained in the Physical Efficiency Test.

Candidates scoring less than 30% marks in the written examination will be disqualified from the Physical Efficiency Test. Based on written exam marks, candidates equal to 5 (five) times the number of vacancies for each reservation category will be shortlisted for PET. The appointing authority for selected candidates is the Commandant, Bihar Home Guard, Patna.

Each correct answer carries 1 mark. Minimum qualifying marks: 30%. The written exam is qualifying only - not the basis for final merit list.

If examination is held in multiple sessions/shifts, normalized marks will be calculated using Equi-Percentile Method. OMR answer sheets (carbon copy) will be retained for one year after final selection list is published.

Only one online application can be submitted per candidate. If multiple applications are submitted by a candidate, all will be rejected and legal action may also be taken.

In Part 1, candidates register with their name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, domicile, reservation category, gender, and date of birth, followed by fee payment. After successful payment, Registration ID and Password are sent via SMS and Email. In Part 2, candidates fill in father/husband name, mother's name, address, educational qualifications, upload photograph and signature, and finally submit the application.

BPSC 72nd CCE Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on 01-08-2026 (the date for age calculation). Reservation benefits are available only to original residents of Bihar - candidates residing outside Bihar are not eligible for reservation. Candidates outside Bihar can apply under the Unreserved (UR) category only. A permanent residential address proof is mandatory for reservation claims.

The educational qualification must be from a recognized University. Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification on the closing date of application submission; admission at all stages is provisional and subject to eligibility verification. BPSC 72nd CCE Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for BPSC 72nd CCE Recruitment 2026 consists of 3 (three) successive stages - Preliminary Examination (Part-1), Main (Written) Examination (Part-2), and Personality Test/Interview (Part-3), followed by a Medical Examination. The Preliminary Examination is a qualifying/screening test only - marks obtained in it will not be counted for the final merit list. Candidates qualifying the Mains will be called for Personality Test at 2.5 times the number of vacancies (category-wise).

Candidates must mandatorily select their service/post preference in the Main Exam online application - no post/service preference claim will be entertained later.

How to Apply for BPSC 72nd CCE Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the BPSC Online Application Portal (bpsconline.bihar.gov.in), accessible on the official website https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in. Hard copy applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal will be active from 07-05-2026 to 31-05-2026. New users must complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the BPSC portal - only one OTR per candidate is permitted. Multiple OTR registrations can lead to rejection of candidature.

All supporting documents must be uploaded in PDF format (max 100 KB per document) at the time of filling the online application. A valid and working email ID and mobile number are mandatory and must be kept active until final results are published. Candidates must upload a live webcam photograph during application - the background must be white or light-coloured with sufficient light. Hindi and English signatures must both be scanned and uploaded (jpg/jpeg format, max 15 KB, dimensions 220x100 pixels).

NPSC CESE 2026 Recruitment - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (02-06-2026). Only those candidates who possess the requisite qualification acquired from a recognized university/institution at the time of applying will be eligible. Merely registering or appearing in the examination does not make a candidate eligible. The post-wise minimum educational qualification requirements are as follows:

For Assistant Professors - Hr. Education Department: Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 55% marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC). Candidates who have been awarded Ph.D. in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET requirement. NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Degree Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET accredited test is not conducted.

For Assistant Professors - CTE (Hr. Education Department): Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 55% marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC/differently abled candidates). Candidates applying for CTE posts must appear for separate Optional Papers as per the examination pattern.

For Lecturers - Technical Education Department: (i) Civil Engineering: B.E/B.Tech with minimum 60% aggregate or 1st Class. (ii) Electronics & Electrical Engineering: B.E/B.Tech with minimum 60% aggregate or 1st Class. (iii) M.Sc Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics/English with 60% (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST).

For Lecturers/WET/Research Associate (RA)/Training-Cum: Post Graduate with 50% Marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC category).

For PGT - School Education Department: Post Graduate with 50% Marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC/differently abled candidates).

For Graduate Teachers - School Education Department: Graduate/Post Graduate with 50% Marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC/differently abled candidates).

How to Apply for NPSC CESE 2026 Recruitment

Applications must be submitted online only through the NPSC portal at https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in. No hard copy applications will be accepted. The OTR (One Time Registration) starts from 12-05-2026 (Noon) and closes on 02-06-2026 (Noon). Candidates who have previously completed the OTR process may directly submit the online application. Candidates are requested to complete OTR at the earliest to avoid online traffic/complications due to last-minute submission.

Only those candidates with requisite qualification for CESE-2026 may register. Government employees must submit a "NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE" signed by the Head of the Department at the time of submission of the online application form. For any assistance/clarification, candidates may refer to FAQs from the Commission's website or call the Helpdesk No. +91 9402988506 on working days (10:00 AM to 03:00 PM). Any issues/complaints must be settled on or before the last date of submission - no issues/complaints will be entertained thereafter.

Documents to be Submitted when Called by Commission:

  • HSLC/Matriculation/Equivalent Admit Card for proof of Date of Birth (no other certificate will be accepted for age proof)
  • Educational Qualification Certificates - Mark Sheets & Pass certificates/provisional pass certificates from matriculation onwards till requisite qualification
  • Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Scheduled Tribe Certificate, Backward Tribe Certificate (as applicable) - signed only by District Authority not below the rank of Additional Deputy Commissioner
  • For PwBDs - certificate from competent medical authority in Form C, D & E as mandated in No.NPSC/EXAM-2/2025 dt 07.08.2025
  • SC/ST & B.T. Certificates as relevant
  • All documents/certificates must be duly signed by the concerned authority

Apply Online at: https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in

  • Only those candidates who possess the requisite qualification from a recognized university/institution at the time of applying will be eligible.
  • No hard copy/offline applications will be accepted - online submission only.
  • OTR (One Time Registration) is free of cost; examination fee of Rs. 300/- + Rs. 25/- convenience fee + gateway charges is payable.
  • Candidates who have previously completed OTR may directly submit the online application.
  • Government employees must produce NOC signed by Head of Department at the time of online application submission.
  • HSLC/Matriculation/Equivalent Admit Card is the only accepted proof of date of birth - no other certificate will be accepted.
  • Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, ST, SC and B.T. Certificates must be signed by District Authority not below the rank of Additional Deputy Commissioner.
  • Suppression of facts or furnishing false/incorrect information will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • The Score Sheet for Academic weightage will be notified and uploaded on the website at a later date.
  • Candidates are advised to complete OTR at the earliest to avoid last-minute technical issues.

WBPSC Miscellaneous Services Eligibility Criteria 13/2024

Nationality: Candidate must be a citizen of India or such other nationals as declared eligible by the Govt. of India.

Essential Educational Qualification (as on closing date)

  • A degree from a recognized University or its equivalent.
  • Ability to read, write and speak in Bengali (not required for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali).
  • Knowledge of Bengali will be tested at the time of Personality Test for candidates whose mother tongue is other than Bengali/Nepali.

N.B. : Candidates must fulfill the requisite qualifications by the closing date of submission of application.

WBPSC Miscellaneous Services Age Limit 2024

Crucial date: 01.01.2024

  • Not below 20 years but not more than 39 years (i.e., born not earlier than 02.01.1985 and not later than 01.01.2004).

Age Relaxation:

  • SC & ST of West Bengal: 5 years
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) of West Bengal: 3 years
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Up to 45 years
  • No relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates of other States (treated as General)

N.B. : Age as recorded only in the Madhyamik or equivalent certificate will be accepted.

WBPSC Miscellaneous Services Application Fee 13/2024

  • General / OBC: ₹160/- (plus service charges wherever applicable)
  • SC / ST of West Bengal & PwBD (40% and above): Nil (exempted)
  • Payment through online mode only.

No claim for refund of fee will be entertained.

WBPSC Miscellaneous Services Selection Process 13/2024

The examination will be held in three successive stages:

  1. Preliminary Examination (Objective Type) – Screening Test only
  2. Final Examination (Conventional Type – Written)
  3. Personality Test
  • Final merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in Final Examination and Personality Test taken together.
  • Preliminary marks will not be counted for final selection.
  • Negative marking for wrong answers in Preliminary Examination.
  • Qualifying marks in aggregate (Written + Personality Test): UR/EWS – 40%, OBC – 38%, SC – 35%, ST/PwBD – 30%, MSP – 40%.

WBPSC Miscellaneous Services 13/2024 Documents Required

Candidates must upload/produce originals at document verification / Personality Test:

  • Madhyamik or equivalent certificate (for age proof)
  • Degree certificate & mark sheets
  • Caste / Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) issued by competent authority of West Bengal
  • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
  • Meritorious Sportsperson certificate (in prescribed Form 1/2/3/4)
  • Photo ID proof (Voter ID, Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence, etc.)
  • Bengali knowledge will be tested at Personality Test (wherever applicable)

How to Apply for WBPSC Miscellaneous Services 13/2024

Posts (Sl. Nos. 12 to 19) Pay Level-9 (₹28,900 - ₹74,500)

Mandatory Domicile Requirement Permanent Resident Certificate of Tripura (PRTC) - mandatory for all applicants as per GA(P&T) Department Notification dated 07-07-2023.
Desirable Knowledge in Bengali or Kokborok.

Tripura PSC ATO Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be at least 18 years and not more than 40 years of age as on 05-06-2026. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for ST, SC, Physically Handicapped, and Government employee candidates. However, Government Employees belonging to ST/SC/Physically Handicapped category shall not get this additional relaxation over and above the general relaxation of 5 years already available to them.

There is no fixed number of attempts for the examination - candidates can apply and appear multiple times as long as they are otherwise eligible and within the prescribed upper age limit for their category.

Category Age Limit
General (UR) 18 to 40 years (as on 05-06-2026)
ST / SC / Physically Handicapped / Govt. Employees 5 years relaxation (max 45 years)
ST/SC/PH who are also Govt. Employees Only 5 years total relaxation (no additional relaxation over and above the 5 years)

Tripura PSC ATO Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying for the post of Assistant Technical Officer are required to pay a non-refundable recruitment fee as specified below. The fee must be paid online through the TPSC application portal. Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Candidates submitting incomplete applications or applications without the requisite recruitment fee will have their candidature rejected. Candidates are therefore advised to confirm their eligibility and verify all details before making payment.

Category Recruitment Fee
General Candidates (UR) Rs. 350/- (Rupees Three Hundred and Fifty only)
ST / SC / BPL Card Holders / Physically Handicapped Candidates Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only)

Tripura PSC ATO Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for TPSC ATO Recruitment 2026 consists of 2 (two) successive stages - a Written Examination of 170 marks (MCQ-based, 3 hours) and an Interview/Personality Test of 30 marks. Candidates who qualify the written examination will be called for the Interview/Personality Test in the ratio as specified below.

No candidate will be called for the personality test unless he/she appears in the written examination. The final merit list and selection will be based on the combined total marks (written + interview), prepared in order of merit. If a candidate remains absent in the interview/personality test, his/her candidature will not be considered for final selection.

The selection list recommended by the Commission remains valid for 6 months from the date of recommendation, extendable up to 1 year in consultation with the Government.

Stage 1 - Written Examination

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Ability Test OMR Based MCQ 50 180 Minutes (3 Hours)
Paper II Job Oriented Subjects - Technical Paper OMR Based MCQ 120
Grand Total (Written) 170  

Stage 2 - Interview / Personality Test: 30 Marks

Shortlisting Ratio for Interview (Category-wise)

Number of Vacancies (Category-wise) Number of Candidates to be Called for Personality Test

Reserved Categories (SC/ST/PH etc.) Minimum 45% in each subject

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Seniority of age (older candidate preferred)
2nd Tie-Break Percentage of marks in the minimum prescribed educational qualification (if age is also equal)

Tripura PSC ATO Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

The Written Examination consists of two papers - Paper I (General Ability Test, 50 marks) and Paper II (Job Oriented Technical Paper, 120 marks). All questions are OMR-based MCQ type, answered in English only. Negative marking will apply as per TPSC norms amended from time to time. The detailed syllabus is reproduced below from Annexure-B and Annexure-C of the official notification (as published in the Tripura Gazette Extraordinary Issue, February 25, 2026).

Paper I - General Ability Test (50 Marks, 50 Questions of 1 Mark each)

Sl. No. Topic Marks
1 English - Synonyms, Antonyms, Phrases & Idioms, Prepositions, Articles, Comprehension, Ordering of words in a sentence, Ordering of sentences, Spotting errors, Appropriate and qualifying words. (OMR MCQ - 15 Questions, 1 mark each) 15
2 General Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning - Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Quantitative and Qualitative abilities, General Aptitude. (OMR MCQ - 15 Questions, 1 mark each) 15
3 General Knowledge & Current Affairs - (i) General Knowledge with special reference to Tripura and Northeastern States; (ii) Elementary knowledge of Indian History and Indian Geography; (iii) Current events and problems with special reference to Tripura, India and world. (OMR MCQ - 20 Questions, 1 mark each) 20
Total 50

Paper II - Job Oriented Technical Paper (Full Marks: 120, OMR MCQ - 120 Questions of 1 Mark each)

Section Topic Key Sub-Topics
Engineering Mathematics Section 1: Probability and Statistics Random variables; Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions; Mean, median, mode, standard deviation; Conditional probability and Bayes theorem.
Computer Science & IT Section 2: Digital Logic Boolean algebra, Combinational and sequential circuits, Minimization, Number representations and computer arithmetic (fixed and floating point).
Computer Science & IT Section 3: Computer Organization and Architecture Machine instructions and addressing modes, ALU, data path and control unit; Instruction pipelining, pipeline hazards; Memory hierarchy (cache, main memory, secondary storage); I/O interface (interrupt and DMA mode).
Computer Science & IT Section 4: Analog and Digital Communication Autocorrelation and power spectral density; White noise filtering; Random signals through LTI systems; AM and FM modulation/demodulation; PCM, DPCM, digital modulation schemes (ASK, PSK, FSK, QAM); Error correction, Hamming codes; TDMA, FDMA, CDMA.
Computer Science & IT Section 5: Data Structures and Programming Arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, binary search trees, binary heaps, graphs; Programming in C, C++, Java; Recursion.
Computer Science & IT Section 6: Algorithms Searching, sorting, hashing; Asymptotic worst-case time and space complexity; Greedy, dynamic programming, divide and conquer; Graph traversals, minimum spanning trees, shortest paths.
Computer Science & IT Section 7: Compiler Design Lexical analysis, parsing, syntax-directed translation; Runtime environments; Intermediate code generation; Local optimization; Data flow analyses (constant propagation, liveness analysis, common subexpression elimination).
Computer Science & IT Section 8: Operating System System calls, processes, threads, inter-process communication, concurrency and synchronization; Deadlock; CPU and I/O scheduling; Memory management and virtual memory; File systems.
Computer Science & IT Section 9: Databases ER model, Relational model, relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL; Integrity constraints, normal forms; File organization, indexing (B and B+ trees); Transactions and concurrency control.
Computer Science & IT Section 10: Information Systems and Software Engineering Information gathering, requirement and feasibility analysis, data flow diagrams, process specifications, input/output design, process life cycle, planning and managing the project, design, coding, testing, implementation, maintenance.
Computer Science & IT Section 11: Computer Networks OSI and TCP/IP protocol stacks; Data link layer (framing, error detection, MAC, Ethernet bridging); Routing protocols; IP addressing, IPv4, CIDR, NAT; Transport layer (UDP, TCP, flow/congestion control); Application layer protocols (DNS, SMTP, HTTP, FTP, Email).
Computer Science & IT Section 12: Web Technologies HTML5, CSS3, XML; Client-server computing; Web server; Proxy server; Web application development; MVC Architecture; Web services; Frontend technologies.
Computer Science & IT Section 13: Cyber Security and Emerging Technologies Secure programming techniques; OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities; Concepts on IoT; Blockchain; AI.
Computer Science & IT Section 14: Cloud Technology Cloud Computing; Compute, Network, Storage Management Technologies; Edge Computing.

How to Apply for Tripura PSC ATO Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the TPSC Online Application Portal, accessible on the official website https://tpsc.tripura.gov.in. Hard copy applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal will be active from 12-05-2026 to 05-06-2026 (5:30 PM). New users (first-time applicants) must complete One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) on the TPSC website before applying - a User ID will be generated and sent to the registered mobile number/email ID upon successful registration.

Existing OTPR users can directly apply using their User ID. Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications; if done unavoidably, only the application with the latest Application Number will be considered valid, and fee paid against other application numbers will not be adjusted. After the closing date, a 7-day correction window will be available for making corrections in the application form - no changes are allowed after this window closes. Candidates are not required to upload supporting documents at the time of online application; documents will be called after the written examination result is published.

Documents to be Submitted After Written Examination (on being called):

  • Age proof - Birth Certificate or Admit Card of Madhyamik examination
  • Educational qualifications (Madhyamik onwards) - marksheets and certificates
  • ST / SC / PH / Ex-SM certificate (if applicable)
  • Permanent Resident Certificate of Tripura (PRTC)
  • Online application form duly filled up

Documents to be submitted to the Reception Counter of TPSC or by post to: The Secretary, TPSC, Agartala, PIN-799001 within the time specified. Non-submission within the specified time will result in cancellation of candidature.

Apply Online at: https://tpsc.tripura.gov.in

Important Instructions for Tripura PSC ATO Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only bonafide citizens of India with valid PRTC are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification on the closing date of application.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted - online submission only.
  • Recruitment fee is non-refundable; incomplete applications without fee will be rejected.
  • Government employees must produce NOC at the time of interview if application not routed through Proper Channel.
  • Mobile phones and electronic gadgets are banned inside examination/interview premises.
  • Examination venue closed 10 minutes before scheduled commencement - latecomers not allowed.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://tpsc.tripura.gov.in regularly for updates on recruitment steps.
  • Questions in all papers to be answered in English only - no other language permitted.
  • Negative marking on MCQ questions will apply as per TPSC norms.
  • For any eligibility-related enquiry, candidates should approach the concerned Government Department - the Commission will not entertain such representations.
  • All decisions of the Commission regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding.

Candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation must attach supporting certificates. For Institute's own employees, there is no upper age limit, subject to at least one year of service remaining till superannuation on the last date of application submission. IISER Mohali Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

The selection process consists of multiple stages conducted by the Scrutiny/Selection Committee of IISER Mohali. The minimum qualifying marks for written/interview/skill tests will be as per standards fixed by the Institute at its discretion. The scheme of examination and syllabus for all posts will be announced at a later date on the Institute's website. Mere fulfilment of minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for test/interview.

Candidates selected to appear for the interview for Group A posts shall be reimbursed travel fare as follows - By Railways: AC II Tier; By Airways: up to 1000 km: Rs. 12,000/-; 1001–1500 km: Rs. 18,000/- (or actual, whichever is less); above 1500 km: Rs. 24,000/-. Air/Rail fare reimbursement is only on production of authentic tickets booked via authorized travel agents as per DoPT OM dated 29.08.2022.

Stage Description

Stage 4 Publication of final remarks of Scrutiny Committee on Institute website; no reconsideration request entertained after this stage

Applications must be submitted online only at erp.iisermohali.ac.in. Applications received in hard copy format or any other mode will be summarily rejected. The last date is 15/06/2026 up to 05:00 PM. Candidates are advised to submit well before the closing date to avoid connectivity issues due to heavy load on the website. Once submitted, the application cannot be withdrawn under any circumstances and no editing will be allowed. All correspondence including admit cards will be sent to the registered email ID only - no hard copy letters will be sent.

Candidates serving in Central Government / State Government / Semi-Government / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies must upload the NOC/Forwarding Letter (Annexure-A) and Experience Certificate (Annexure-B) from their current employer before the last date of application, or submit by email to [email protected] before the date of written exam/interview.

Documents to be Produced at Written Test / Skill Test / Interview:

  • Original documents of all educational qualifications with mark sheets
  • Experience certificates clearly mentioning date of joining/promotion, Pay Level/Grade Pay, period of employment, and nature of duties
  • Category certificate - SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/ESM (if applicable)
  • NOC / Forwarding letter from current employer (Annexure-A) - for Govt./PSU employees
  • Self-declaration for OBC-NCL (Annexure-I format)
  • Any other documents supporting claims made in the application form

Apply Online at: https://erp.iisermohali.ac.in/Online Recruitment Application IISERM.action

Important Instructions for IISER Mohali Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • The applicant must be a citizen of India. All posts are regular and permanent (except Lien vacancies).
  • Selected candidates will be covered under the National Pension System (NPS).
  • Candidates must satisfy themselves of the suitability for the position before applying - minimum essential qualifications are compulsory regardless of higher qualifications held.
  • CGPA to percentage conversion will be done as per formula of the degree-awarding institution.
  • OBC-NCL certificate must have been issued within 2 years of the last date of application and a self-declaration (Annexure-I) must also be submitted.

  • If caste/category certificate is in a language other than Hindi or English, a certified translation must be produced at the time of interview/document verification.
  • Candidates must disclose details of any close relatives employed at IISER Mohali, and any penalties/inquiry against them in the application.
  • Canvassing in any form or bringing political or any other influence will be treated as disqualification.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must pay the application fee separately for each post.
  • No hard copy/postal applications will be entertained - online mode only.
  • Once submitted, the application cannot be edited or withdrawn under any circumstances.
  • All correspondence will be made via registered email only - no separate hard copy letters will be sent.
  • Candidates selected for Group A post interviews are eligible for travel reimbursement (AC II Tier by rail; air fare as per slab with authorized travel agent tickets only).
  • Any corrigendum/addendum shall be published only on the Institute website. Candidates are advised to visit www.iisermohali.ac.in regularly.
  • Any legal dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to jurisdiction of the Hon'ble Punjab and Haryana High Court, Chandigarh only.
  • In case of ambiguity between Hindi and English versions of the advertisement, the English version shall prevail.
  • All decisions of the Competent Authority, IISER Mohali regarding eligibility, acceptance/rejection, selection, and related matters are final and binding.

A total of 09 posts have been announced for contractual engagement under the NAKSHA Scheme's State Programme Management Unit (SPMU). The tenure for all posts is initially one year. The post-wise vacancy and salary details are given in the table below.

Punjab Revenue Department Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, work experience, and age limit for the respective post. Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications are liable to be rejected. Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply. The post-wise eligibility criteria are given below.

  • Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • ODL Restriction: Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible.
  • Foreign Degree: Candidates possessing degrees from foreign universities must produce an equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi at the time of interview or while applying.

Post-wise Educational Qualification & Work Experience

Post Name Educational Qualification & Work Experience Required
Project Coordinator Education: Master's in Engineering / Business Administration / Development Studies / Social Work OR Bachelor's in Engineering / Science or related field.

Work Experience: 1) Minimum 5 years' experience in implementing and coordinating projects related to Central/State Government programmes or public/private sector schemes. 2) Proven track record in data analysis, project management and coordination, demonstrating effective leadership and problem-solving skills in achieving project objectives and ensuring smooth programme operations.
Expert (Land Administration) Work Experience: Retired Civil Service Officers with a minimum of 10 years of experience in land administration, revenue/registration/consolidation/survey.
Manager (Geospatial Technology) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognized University or Institute in a relevant field such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Geomatics Engineering, or related disciplines. GATE qualified and certification in GIS/Data analysis related courses with knowledge of ArcGIS/QGIS and other software related to GIS data processing and management is desirable.

Work Experience: At least 5 years of experience in managing and execution of GIS-related projects. Proficiency in utilising GIS software such as ArcGIS, QGIS and other relevant tools for spatial data processing, mapping and database management.
Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science, preferably in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience in database administration, encompassing database design, implementation, optimisation and maintenance. Proficiency in GIS-based software tool development, with a track record of designing and deploying solutions to meet project requirements.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in maintaining High Resolution Satellite Imageries and software tools like ERDAS Imagine, LPS, QGIS, ArcGIS is preferred. Demonstrated proficiency in Ortho rectification, mosaicking, analysis using satellite data to meet project requirements and objectives.
Data Entry Operator Education: Bachelor's degree in any stream.

Work Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience and proficient typing skills in either English or Punjabi are preferred. Possession of valid certification in MS Word and MS Excel / MS Office issued by a recognised institute certified under ISO standards is desirable.

The application process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed proforma through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ on or before 15/05/2026. Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications (without photograph, signature, mark sheets, or incomplete in any respect) will not be considered. The step-by-step process to apply is given below.

  • Visit the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ and find the NAKSHA Scheme recruitment advertisement.
  • Download and fill the prescribed application proforma carefully with all required details.
  • Attach attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post.
  • If Grades/CGPA are awarded instead of marks, candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per the University's conversion procedure and submit necessary proof. Rounding off of percentage of marks/CGPA grading is not allowed.
  • Submit the completed application online at https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ before the closing date of 15/05/2026.

AIIMS Rishikesh Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Professor - Medical Candidates: A medical qualification included in Schedule I, II, or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 along with a postgraduate degree such as MD/MS or equivalent in the respective discipline. For surgical super-specialties, M.Ch. is required; for medical super-specialties, D.M. is required (2, 3, or 5-year recognized course). Experience required: 14 years after MD/MS, or 12 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course after MBBS), or 11 years after a 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Master's degree + Doctorate degree from a recognized university + 14 years of teaching/research experience after obtaining the doctorate.

Additional Professor - Medical Candidates: Same basic qualifications as Professor (Medical). Experience: 10 years after MD/MS; for super-specialty disciplines, 8 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course), or 7 years after 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 10 years of experience after the doctorate.

Associate Professor - Medical Candidates (General Disciplines): Same as Professor (Medical) + 6 years of experience after MD/MS. For super-specialty disciplines, 4 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course), or 3 years after 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 6 years of experience after the doctorate.

Assistant Professor - Medical Candidates (General Disciplines): Same as Professor (Medical) + 3 years of experience after MD/MS. For super-specialty disciplines, 1 year after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course after MBBS); no experience required for candidates with 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 3 years of experience after the doctorate.

Hospital Administration Department: A medical qualification under Schedule I & II or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, along with MD in Hospital Administration or a Master's Degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) from an MCI recognized institution. Experience varies by post: 14 years (Professor), 10 years (Additional Professor), 6 years (Associate Professor), or 3 years (Assistant Professor) after obtaining the postgraduate degree.

UKSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

(ii) For Departmental Employees only (विभागीय कार्मिकों हेतु) Departmental employees who have completed 5 years of continuous service from the date of recruitment AND have passed Intermediate (10+2) with Biology or Agriculture from Uttarakhand Board of Secondary Education, Uttarakhand Board of University Education, or UP Board of Secondary Education, or any equivalent exam recognised by the Government.

Pre-Appointment Training Note: Selected candidates for Livestock Extension Officer will undergo 06 months training at the Departmental Training Centre and 06 months training at Departmental Veterinary Hospitals under the supervision of Veterinary Officers before being appointed to vacancies. UKSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

The selection process consists of an Objective Type (MCQ) Written Examination of 100 marks and 2 hours duration. The questions will be related to the educational qualification prescribed for the post. Document verification is mandatory after the written examination result. The final selection list will be published on the Commission's website.

Subject Type Total Questions Maximum Marks Duration
Biology, Agriculture and Animal Husbandry (जीव विज्ञान, कृषि एवं पशुपालन) Objective MCQ (OMR/CBT) 100 100 2 Hours

Exam Mode: The Commission may conduct the examination in Offline (OMR-based) or Online (Computer Based Test / CBT) mode depending on the number of applicants.

OMR-based Exam Rules: OMR answer sheets are in triplicate. Candidates must mandatorily submit the original and second copy to the invigilator after the exam; the third copy may be retained. Use of whitener or scratching on OMR is strictly prohibited and will attract negative marking. Candidates must not write incorrect roll numbers or booklet series codes on the OMR sheet, else their candidature will be cancelled automatically.

UKSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 – Exam Syllabus

Written Examination – One Paper: Biology, Agriculture and Animal Husbandry (100 Marks, 100 Questions, 2 Hours)

Note: Part A is compulsory for all candidates. Part B (Biology – Botany and Zoology) and Part C (Agriculture and Animal Husbandry) are optional; candidates must choose any one of Part B or C.

Part A – Compulsory for All (30 Marks)

Topic Key Sub-Topics
Cell Biology Protoplasm, Cell Theory, Prokaryotic & Eukaryotic cells, Plasma membrane, Cytoplasm, Cytoskeleton, Centrioles, Endoplasmic Reticulum, Golgi Complex, Mitochondria, Lysosomes, Plastids, Ribosomes, Nucleus & Nucleolus, Chromosomes (structure, size, shape), Cell division
Chemical Constituents of Living Cells Structure and classification of Proteins, Carbohydrates and Lipids
Taxonomy Concept of species, Nomenclature, Linnaean Hierarchy, Five Kingdom Classification, Monera, Protista and Fungi — salient features; Lichens; Viruses and Viroids; Angiosperm families: Brassicaceae, Fabaceae, Cucurbitaceae, Malvaceae, Solanaceae, Poaceae
Morphology and Anatomy of Flowering Plants Root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit and seed (Dicots and Monocots)
Plant Physiology Water and mineral absorption, Transpiration, Carbon assimilation & Photosynthesis, Respiration, Electron Transfer System, Translocation, Plant growth regulators
Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants Male and female gametophyte development, Pollination, Fertilization (double fertilization), Endosperm and embryo development, Seed and fruit formation, Seed dispersal, Apomixis, Parthenocarpy, Polyembryony
Pollution (Types and Control) Pollution-associated health hazards, Eutrophication, Biomagnification, Ozone Layer depletion, Green House Effect, Acid Rain, Green Revolution, Nitrogen Cycle, Apiculture, Sericulture, Crop pests management, Microbes and Human welfare

Part B – Biology (Botany and Zoology) – 70 Marks [OPTIONAL – any one of B or C]

Unit Key Topics
Unit-I Origin of life and evolution (Evolutionary theories, Evidence, Recapitulation, Lamarckism, Darwin, Weismann, Modern synthetic theory, De Vries, Gene flow, Hardy-Weinberg); Adaptations (Hydrophytes, Xerophytes, Sciophytes, Heliophytes; Terrestrial, Cursorial, Scansorial, Volant, Aquatic, Fossorial animals); Adaptive radiation; Fossilization; Human evolution
Unit-II Cytology (Light & Phase Contrast Microscopy, TEM, SEM; Plasma Membrane; Cytoplasm; Cytoskeleton; Centrioles; Endoplasmic Reticulum; Golgi; Mitochondria; Lysosomes; Plastids; Ribosomes; Nucleus; Nucleosome model; Eukaryotic chromosome; Polytene & Lampbrush chromosomes; Cell division); Chemical constituents; Genetic material (DNA, RNA); Genetics (Mendel's laws, Back/Test cross, Incomplete dominance, Co-dominance, Multiple alleles, Sex determination); Human Genetics (Haemophilia, colour blindness, Down's syndrome, Turner's, Klinefelter's, Thalassemia); Linkage; Crossing over; Mutations; Enzymes; Plant and animal tissue systems
Unit-III Taxonomy (species concept, Five kingdom classification, Monera, Protista, Fungi, Lichens, Viruses, Viroids, Prions; Fungi, Bacteria, Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms — general characteristics, habitat, ecology, economic importance)
Unit-IV Angiosperms — classification types; Families (Ranunculaceae, Malvaceae, Brassicaceae, Fabaceae, Meliaceae, Apiaceae, Rosaceae, Rutaceae, Lamiaceae, Solanaceae, Asteraceae, Euphorbiaceae, Liliaceae, Poaceae); Pollination; Physiology (Water transport, Transpiration, Guttation, Mineral Nutrition); Photosynthesis; Respiration; Plant growth regulators
Unit-V Non-Chordata — Protozoa (Amoeba, Euglena, Paramecium; Entamoeba, Plasmodium, Leishmania, Trypanosoma); Metazoa — Porifera, Coelenterata, Helminthes (Taenia, Ascaris, Schistosoma, Wuchereria); Annelida; Arthropoda (Palaemon, Peripatus, Limulus; Anopheles, Culex, Aedes, Xenopsylla, Phlebotomus); Mollusca; Echinodermata
Unit-VI Chordata — Hemichordata, Urochordata, Cephalochordata, Cyclostomata, Pisces, Dipnoi, Amphibia, Reptilia (Chelonia, Ophidia, Crocodilia), Aves, Mammalia (Prototheria, Metatheria, Eutheria)
Unit-VII Metabolism (Carbohydrates, Proteins, Lipids); Skeletal System; Digestive System; Vertebrate Respiration; Circulatory System (Open & Closed, ECG, cardiovascular disorders); Excretion (ammonotelism, ureotelism, uricotelism; Kidney, Dialysis); Endocrine System (Glands, Hormones, Pheromones); Nervous System; Reproductive System
Unit-VIII Embryology; Animal Behaviour (Taxis, Kinesis, Instinct, Learning, Imprinting, Biological rhythms, Echolocation); Economic Botany (Plants in Human Welfare, Forests, Fruits, Cereals, Spices); Economic Zoology (Animal Husbandry — cattle breeds, AI, Poultry, Pisciculture, Sericulture, Apiculture, Integrated Pest Management)
Unit-IX Biogeochemical cycles; Ecosystem (Types, Trophic levels, Energy flow, Food web, Ecological pyramids, Plant succession); Population Estimation; Biodiversity (In situ & ex situ conservation, Hotspots, Ramsar sites, CITES, IUCN, Protected Areas, Tiger Reserves); Pollution
Unit-X Biotechnology (Nucleic acids, Genome, Recombinant DNA, Blotting, Cloning, PCR, Electrophoresis, DNA fingerprinting); Plant tissue culture (Totipotency, Callus culture); Plant breeding (Hybridization, Hybrid vigour); Biostatistics (Sampling, Central tendency, Dispersion, Standard deviation)

Part C – Agriculture and Animal Husbandry – 70 Marks [OPTIONAL – any one of B or C]

Unit Key Topics
Unit-I Importance of agriculture in national & Uttarakhand state economy; Classification of field crops; Crop production principles; Cultivation of common crops — Cereals: paddy, maize, wheat, barley, oat, sorghum, pearl millet, finger millet; Oilseed Crops: rapeseed, mustard, linseed, sunflower, soybean, groundnut, sesame; Pulses: chickpea, field pea, lentil, rajma, pigeon pea, mung bean, urd bean, cluster bean; Fodder: oat, berseem, lucerne, cowpea; Cash Crop: sugarcane; Fibre Crops: jute, cotton; Green manuring; Weed control; Irrigation; Sustainable agriculture; Precision farming; Organic farming; Biofertilizers; National & international agriculture institutions; Agroforestry; General agriculture in Uttarakhand
Unit-II Importance of horticulture in Uttarakhand; Classification of horticultural crops; Cultivation of fruit crops (mango, banana, litchi, grape, papaya, guava, apple, peach, pear, plum, apricot, pomegranate, sapota, custard apple, jackfruit, strawberry); Vegetable crops; Floriculture crops (rose, gladiolus, marigold, lilium, chrysanthemum, carnation, gerbera, tuberose); Medicinal and aromatic crops (ashwagandha, sarpagandha, aloe vera, isabgol, lemon grass, citronella, mint, vetiver, palmarosa); Plantation crops (tea, coffee, cashew, rubber, coconut); Nursery management; Hydroponics; Mushroom production; Pre and post harvest management; General horticulture in Uttarakhand
Unit-III Soils — origin, classification, profile, composition, physical & chemical properties, soil health management, soil fertility & productivity, essential plant nutrients (macro & micro), fertilizer principles & methods, soil water, soil temperature, soil pollution, problematic soils, soil erosion, fertilizer control order, integrated plant nutrient management, agro-climatic zones, climate change and global warming, geo-informatics and remote sensing; General soils information of Uttarakhand
Unit-IV Plant diseases and pathogens; Diseases caused by biotic and abiotic factors; Management of major diseases of agricultural and horticultural crops; Post harvest disease management; Disease etiology, symptomatology, defence mechanisms; Classification of insects; Biotic & abiotic factors for insect infestation; Storage grain pests; Methods of insect pest and disease management; Classification of pesticides; Biopesticides; Economic threshold level; Safety issues; Plant quarantine laws; Agricultural microbiology; Beneficial insects
Unit-V Mendel's Laws; Chromosome structure and aberrations; Cell cycle; Meiosis and mitosis; Linkage and crossing over; Sex chromosomes; Genetic code; Nucleic acid; Replication, Translation, Transcription; Chromosomal theory of inheritance; Mutation; Mode of reproduction; Mode of pollination; Male sterility; Self incompatibility; Plant genetic resources; Centre of origin; Conventional and non-conventional breeding methods; Biotechnology in agriculture; Seeds — characteristics, classes, certification, production techniques, processing, quality, testing, treatment, storage, marketing; Seed Act 1966; Seed Control Order 1983; Protection of Plant Variety and Farmer's Rights Act 2001; Intellectual Property Rights; GI Tag
Unit-VI Plant Cell; Stomata; Diffusion; Osmosis; Water and nutrient uptake; Transpiration; Respiration; Photosynthesis; Plant growth substances; Photoperiodism; Vernalization; Dormancy; Functions of water, carbohydrate, protein, fat, vitamins and minerals; Food processing and preservation; Food and nutrition; Nutritional disorders; Malnutrition; Energy metabolism; Balanced diet; Natural resources; Ecosystem; Biodiversity and conservation; Environmental pollution; Natural and man-made disaster management
Unit-VII Role of livestock in national and Uttarakhand state economy; Major breeds of cow, buffalo, goat, sheep, poultry, pig; Digestive and reproductive system of ruminant and non-ruminant animals; Care and management of cattle and poultry; Principles of feeding various classes of livestock; Housing management; Disease management; Identification methods; Breeding methods; Artificial Insemination; Castration; Classification of common feeds, fodders and ration; Operation Flood; Milk (physical & chemical properties, adulteration); Composition of milk and colostrum; Processing of milk (filtration, Bactofugation, Pasteurization, Standardization, Homogenization, Cream separation, centrifugation); Indigenous milk products: paneer, chhena, ghee, khoa, dahi, shrikhand; Other milk products: cream, butter, ice-cream, condensed milk, milk powder, cheese
Unit-VIII Introductory agricultural economics — macroeconomics, microeconomics, agricultural planning and development; Demand, supply, price policies; National income, banking, tax, economic systems; Agriculture finance; Micro finance; Agriculture credit and SWOT analysis; Agriculture cooperation; Cooperative societies; Crop insurance; Agriculture Marketing; Agriculture commodities; Agriculture trade; Farm management principles; Farm business analysis; Production factors; Intensive and extensive agriculture; Agriculture in Five Year Plans; Extension Education; Extension programme planning; Extension systems in India
Unit-IX Status and source of farm power; Working principles of IC engines; Different systems of IC engines; Power transmission system; Tractor, seed drill, seed cum fertilizer drill, power tiller, power weeder; Primary and secondary tillage implements; Implements for hill agriculture; Plant protection, harvesting and threshing implements; Pumps; Water lifting devices; Discharge; Command area; Calibration of seed drill; Renewable energy and its application in agriculture
Unit-X Measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode); Geometric mean; Harmonic mean; Measures of dispersion (range, quartile deviation, variance, standard deviation, standard error of mean, coefficient of variation); Correlation and regression; Probability; Skewness and kurtosis; Introduction to computer, operating system, e-agriculture and computer models in agriculture
NOTE: Current General Knowledge and scientific advancement related to the above units are also deemed to be included in the syllabus.

Applications must be submitted online only through the UKSSSC portal www.sssc.uk.gov.in. No manual or postal applications will be accepted. The online portal will be active from 13 May 2026 to 02 June 2026. A correction window will be available from 05 June 2026 to 07 June 2026.

Step Action

Important Instructions for UKSSSC Livestock Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Online applications only — no manual or postal applications will be accepted.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility conditions (educational qualification, age, domicile, employment registration) before applying. Admission at all stages is provisional and candidature can be cancelled even after final selection if found ineligible.
  • Candidates must not fill more than one online application form for the same post. If multiple applications are submitted, all will be cancelled. Candidates can cancel and re-apply before the deadline, but fee paid for a cancelled application will not be refunded or adjusted.

  • Signatures on the application, attendance sheet, document verification, and other correspondence must be identical at all places — any discrepancy may result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Each candidate must provide their own separate mobile number and email ID — not shared with other family members.
  • Admit cards will not be sent by post — they must be downloaded from the UKSSSC website. Candidates must regularly check the website throughout the recruitment process.
  • Mobile phones, calculators, pagers, scanners, or any electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. Violation will attract debarment from future UKSSSC exams and further action.
  • Examination centre preferences are taken into account, but the Commission's decision on exam centre allotment is final and binding.
  • Candidates absent during document verification will have their candidature cancelled without any notice.
  • All Uttarakhand State Agitation Activist / dependant certificates must be claimed in the online application form to avail reservation; no benefit is available if not claimed at application stage.
  • No TA/DA is payable to any candidate for attending written examination or document verification.
  • Any person with more than one living spouse, or a woman who has married a person with a living spouse, is not eligible for appointment.
  • All decisions of the Commission regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding. The Commission does not provide individual counselling on eligibility.

UPSSSC AGTA Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises shortlisting on the basis of UPSSSC PET 2025 scores, a mains written examination and document verification. Only PET 2025 qualified candidates will be allowed to appear in the UPSSSC AGTA mains exam.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting through UPSSSC PET 2025

  • Candidates must have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard to apply for the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C mains examination.
  • UPSSSC will prepare a list of eligible candidates for AGTA mains based on PET 2025 scores, reservation rules and post‑wise vacancy distribution.
  • Only shortlisted candidates, as per the criteria given in the official notification, will be permitted to fill the UPSSSC AGTA mains online form and appear for the written exam.

Stage 2 – UPSSSC AGTA Mains Written Examination 2026

  • The mains written exam for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant Group C will be an objective type paper covering agriculture and related subjects as per the prescribed syllabus.
  • The question paper will carry a fixed number of questions and marks (details like total marks, duration and negative marking will be as per the official AGTA notification).
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks and rank high in the merit list to be considered for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 3 – Document Verification

  • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of performance in the AGTA mains written exam will be called for document verification (DV).
  • During DV, candidates must produce original documents and certificates related to age, educational qualification, category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), domicile, PET 2025 score, and other eligibility criteria.
  • Failure to produce valid documents or any discrepancy in information can lead to cancellation of candidature for UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026.

The final selection list for UPSSSC AGTA Recruitment 2026 will be prepared purely on the basis of marks obtained in the mains written examination, subject to successful document verification and fulfilment of all eligibility conditions.

How to Apply for UPSSSC AGTA / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026

The application process for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Only candidates who have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 registration and score can fill the UPSSSC AGTA online form 2026 on the official website upsssc.gov.in.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission at upsssc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: On the home page, click on the “Notifications/Advertisements” section and open the link for Advt. No. 06-Exam/2026 – Technical Assistant Group C (AGTA) Recruitment 2026.
  • Step 3: Read the UPSSSC AGTA Notification 2026 carefully, then click on the “Apply” or “Candidate Registration” link given against the advertisement.
  • Step 4: Log in using your UPSSSC PET 2025 Registration Number, date of birth and other required details; the system will fetch your basic data from the PET database.
  • Step 5: Fill the UPSSSC AGTA online application form 2026 with category, educational qualification, agriculture degree details, reservation information and other required fields.
  • Step 6: Upload your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C notification.
  • Step 7: Pay the UPSSSC AGTA application fee of ₹25 (for all categories) using the available online payment options such as net banking, debit/credit card, SBI I‑Collect or e‑challan.
  • Step 8: Review all the details entered in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C application form carefully, then submit the form and take a printout of the final submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Candidates should complete the UPSSSC AGTA Online Form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.
